channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: openSUSE Leap 16.1
item.description: This is the first minor release in the Leap 16 series and with this release, openSUSE’s immutable server distribution, Leap Micro, becomes part of Leap itself through a new Immutable Mode. Comments (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances in additional AWS Regions
item.description: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances in additional AWS Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools in flows
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now enables you to invoke Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools in customer experience flows through the new 'External Tool' block. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports Cases and External Tool events in the Wait block
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now supports Cases and External Tool events in the Wait block, giving you more control over how your customer experience flows react to real-time data changes. (1 source: aws)

item.title: EC2 Amazon Machine Images can now be scanned for vulnerabilities through Amazon Inspector
item.description: Amazon Inspector now extends its vulnerability scanning to EC2 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), enabling you to identify software vulnerabilities in your AMIs without launching instances or installing additional software. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Textract now available in Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and Europe (Zurich)
item.description: Amazon Textract is now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) and Europe (Zurich) Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Announcing AWS for Fluent Bit 3.0.0 based on Fluent Bit 4.1.1
item.description: AWS for Fluent Bit announces version 3.0.0 , based on Fluent Bit version 4.1.1 and Amazon Linux 2023. (1 source: aws)
